paragraphs: Rav Hoshaya, when he came from Nehardea: Bekhorot 17a; end of the first chapter of Shabbat 19, beginning of b; Chavit 145b. Rav Yosef said, “He has told us of an additional authority.” Abaye replied, “He teaches us much.” When Ravin came he said an incident occurred in Usha at Rav Oshaya’s doorway; they asked Rav Assi, Berakhot, chapter 3, 22, beginning of b.
